## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include migration or compatibility implications when relevant.

## Validation

Record the relevant native tests, strict Clippy/format checks, frontend type check/build and UI/integration checks. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Operational impact

Describe changes to publication, history, schedules, file ownership, authentication, disk/memory bounds or recovery. Include rollout/rollback steps for a breaking change.

- [ ] No secrets, private data or machine-specific artifacts included
- [ ] Documentation matches the resulting commands and configuration
- [ ] Relevant checks pass
